title: 루닉에 관한 중요내용
bodyHtml:
Hanse on Runic Hammers and Intensity

Runics hammers were bumped from 20% increased damage to 35% increased damage when they craft weapons with exceptional quality.

Coupled with the additional bonuses they get, you can craft much better weapons even with a dull copper runic than a normal smith hammer (although, the balance was to make normal smith hammers viable in combat).

Compared to magical loot drops, that's a 70% intensity value for increased damage (although, I believe some artifacts break that rule).


and…


…Here's how intensity works...

Intensity ranges of increased damage on weapons is 1 to 50. An intensity roll for increase damage of 100% is 50 on a weapon. An intensity roll for increase damage of 70% is 35 on a weapon.

Dull copper, copper, bronze, and shadow runics have maximum intensity percentages below 70%. Gold runic and up have a chance to have higher than 70% intensity, although valorite has the highest chance (50% to 100% intensity...which is a damage increase of 25% to 50%). So, you cannot get a weapon with better than 35% damage increase with anything below gold runics. Although, you still can get other magic properites, such as resistances.

The intensity values do not stack with exceptional crafted 35% damage increase. Instead, if you get a better roll than 35%, the exceptional bonus is discarded and the higher value is displayed and used.


=====================================================
Hanse가 이메일로 질문을 받은 후 답변 한 메일입니다.




More on Runic Hammers and Intensity


The modifier for damage increase seems to have been incorrectly calculated with runic hammers. It should not have been additive. This is fixed in publish 19.

Armor gets an exceptional bonus of 15 points with Publish 19, unless you craft with a runic hammer and then you get 6 points for exceptional (because you can get magical modifiers that can boost it beyond 15 points).


and….


Exceptional armor resistances made with runics are staying the same.

-Hanse


You can read the thread here.

In an e-mail discussion group, when Hanse heard that runic hammers were currently making greater than 50% increased damage, he responded:


I heard rumblings that runic crafted weapons were "too good", but those types of reports are a bit vague. As far as missing it altogether, it isn't something folks usually report (oh! I made an item that's better than what I expected!). :)

========================================
다음은 Hanse가 포럼에서 말한 내용입니다.



Slayer Weapons will be Rarer
I tested slayer weapons during publish 19's development. They're all spawning, but are rare to spawn (1% chance or 1 in 100 slayer weapons on average may be a slayer weapon that works on a group of creatures). This chance is IF the slayer effect gets chosen to even be put on a weapon.
========================================
다음은 슬레이어무기에대해 Hanse가 포럼에서 말한 내용입니다.


출처 : UOSS



P.S : 한글번역이 안되시는분은 Hanse에게 한국어로 써달라고 부탁하시거나 멤버분들에게 부탁해보시길 바랍니다.-0-/
